jobs.title: Manager, Sales Strategy & Planning
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity as the Manager, Sales Strategy & Planning
The Manager, Sales Strategy & Planning owns the customer planning story, performance enablement, and cross-functional alignment for assigned customers or channel. This role serves as a strategic business partner to Sales, helping to identify and activate SBA opportunities into customer-specific actions, recommendations and decision-ready planning deliverables.  The position is responsible for enabling high-quality customer plans, capturing customer forecast assumptions, enabling consensus discussions, business reviews, and growth recommendations through strong process leadership and cross-functional influence.

Location: JM Smucker Corporate Offices in Orrville, Ohio

Work Arrangements: Hybrid - onsite during core weeks as determined by the Company (estimated up to 9 days a month); adjusted as the need requires. Intermittent business travel may be required.

In this role you will:
Customer Strategy Planning
- Own the internal customer planning story for assigned customers or channels, including performance, risks, opportunities, actions, and follow-through.
- Support annual planning, Joint Business Planning (JBP), customer business reviews, customer planning cycles, and strategic growth initiatives.
- Translate SBA priorities into customer-specific actions, recommendations, and planning assumptions that connect account-level decisions to the broader SBA, channel, or business plan.
- Facilitate prioritization discussions and planning trade-offs in partnership with Sales and cross-functional stakeholders.

Business Performance Management
- Use data to explain performance, identify risks and opportunities and recommend action for assigned customers or customer portfolios.
- Support gap-solving and prepare clear updates or recommendations for planning, consensus, Stage Gate, resets, and customer decisions.
- Develop data-driven recommendations that support customer outcomes and enterprise objectives.
- Track customer scorecards, risks, opportunities, innovation performance, promotion results, and progress against plans.

Cross-Functional Coordination
- Engage with partners across Sales, Brand Marketing, Category Analytics, Revenue Growth Management, Finance, Supply Chain, Marketing Operations, and other functions to solve customer or plan issues.
- Facilitate planning discussions to ensure key stakeholder alignment across customer priorities, investments, execution plans, and key decisions.
- Drive accountability for planning actions, open issues, and business commitments.
- Ensure customer planning deliverables are clear, decision-ready, and connected to business priorities.

Decision Support & Influence
- Frame alternatives, trade-offs, implications, and recommendations to enable better customer planning and Sales decisions.
- Help stakeholders navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and changing business conditions.
- Support forecasting and planning processes by validating assumptions and escalating issues to the appropriate decision owner.
- Apply standard planning governance while adjusting recommendations to meet customer-specific needs.

Contributing to Organizational Growth & Culture
- Coach Associate Managers and project team members as appropriate.
- Share planning best practices and customer-specific learnings across the organization.
- Model planning discipline, commercial judgment, collaboration, and an ownership mindset.
- Respect all individuals, support efforts for diversity and inclusion, and recognize value in embracing divergent styles.

What we are looking for:
Minimum Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree
- 5 years of experience in Commercial Planning, Sales Planning, Category Management, Customer Strategy, Revenue Growth Management, Finance, Marketing, or related business functions
- Experience in the Convenience Channel both direct and utilizing distributors
- Experience leading cross-functional business initiatives and customer planning activities
- Experience supporting business performance management, planning processes, and decision support
- Strong commercial acumen, analytical capability, communication skills, and stakeholder management skills

Additional skills and experience that we think would make someone successful in this role:
- Sales account ownership
- Consumer Packaged Goods experience
- Experience leading customer planning, JBP development, business reviews, forecasting inputs, or performance management
- Ability to synthesize complex information and develop actionable recommendations
- Experience influencing cross-functional partners and navigating ambiguity
- Experience with business intelligence, retailer, syndicated, or internal reporting tools

jobs.title: Director, Marketing
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity as the Director, Marketing
The Director, Marketing is responsible for setting the vision and strategy for a leading consumer brand and delivering sustainable, profitable growth. This leader owns the brand's annual operating plan, long-term strategy, innovation agenda, integrated marketing approach, revenue growth management and P&L performance. The Director will lead a dedicated brand team and partner closely with Sales, Insights, Research & Development, Operations, Finance, and agency partners to develop and execute the plan. This individual will be a brand builder who leads with a General Manager mindset, balancing creativity and an entrepreneurial approach with strategic discipline, strong business acumen, and decisive execution.

We are hiring Directors for two of our biggest and most dynamic businesses: Folgers coffee and Dog Snacks.
- Folgers is the iconic brand leader in roast & ground coffee. Folgers, along with the Dunkin’ Donuts and Café Bustelo brands, make the coffee portfolio the biggest business within the J.M. Smucker portfolio, and more Americans start their day with a cup of coffee at home from a Smucker coffee brand than any other company!

- The J.M. Smucker Co. is the industry leader in Dog Snacks where the iconic Milk-Bone brand is the #1 in dollars, Canine Carry Outs is the #1 in volume, and Pup-Peroni is a leader in Soft & Chewy. More dog-loving households use a Smucker treat to bring joy and build bonds with their dogs than any other company!

Location: Orrville, OH Corporate Offices

Work Arrangements: Hybrid, onsite approximately 9 days per month during core weeks as determined by the Company; may be more as business needs require

Reports To: Vice President of Marketing

In this role you will:
- Develop and implement the long-term brand strategy and annual operating plan for a category-leading brand/portfolio to deliver growth, market share gains, and stronger brand health.

- Own the brand P&L and deliver annual and long-term top- and bottom-line financial commitments, proactively anticipating and addressing key performance drivers.

- Partner with Brand Experience to develop, execute, and optimize holistic integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, commerce, and traditional media.

- Translate consumer, category, cultural, competitive, and customer insights into clear strategies, compelling brand positioning, and decisive business actions.

- Partner with Innovation and Research & Development to develop a multi-year innovation pipeline linked to the brand strategy and evolving consumer needs.

- Own innovation launch strategy and commercial execution, ensuring launches deliver against consumer, customer, and financial expectations.

- Partner with Sales to develop channel and customer strategies that grow the brand, business, and category. Represent the brand in key customer meetings to understand opportunities and challenges, influence joint business plans, and strengthen commercial execution.

- Identify and deliver margin expansion opportunities through portfolio optimization, cost reduction, value engineering, and supply chain partnership while protecting the consumer experience.

- Build strong, collaborative, and trusting relationships across a highly matrixed organization, balancing brand, business unit, and Company priorities.

- Coach, develop, and motivate a high-performing team, fostering a culture of strategic clarity, creativity, inclusion, collaboration, accountability, and speed to action.

What we are looking for:
- Bachelor's degree required; Master of Business Administration preferred.

- Minimum of 10 years of brand marketing experience, including significant experience in consumer packaged goods; food, beverage or pet experience is preferred.

- Proven track record of delivering top-line growth through demand creation, brand building, innovation, and strong commercial execution.

- Experience developing long-term strategies and annual business plans for a large, established consumer brand or portfolio of brands.

- Demonstrated experience owning a P&L, managing a significant marketing budget, and making trade-offs that improve profitable growth.

- Strong understanding of financial drivers, including pricing, trade, commodities, operations, supply chain, and demand generation.

- Proven ability to develop, inspire, and activate high-performing teams to deliver best-in-class results.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to craft a compelling story and influence at all levels inside and outside the Company.

- Highly collaborative mindset and demonstrated ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams and external partners.

- Ability and willingness to travel within the United States approximately 20% of the time.

Additional skills and experience that would make someone successful in this role:
- Sets a high standard for performance and pursues goals with purpose, sound judgment, and a sense of urgency.

- Leads with a General Manager mindset and balances creativity and entrepreneurship with strategy, discipline, and accountability.

- Comfortable with ambiguity and able to envision future opportunities, make decisions with incomplete information, and adapt quickly.

- Persistent through setbacks and skilled at gaining acceptance for ideas and rallying teams behind a shared vision.

- Deep curiosity about consumers, customers, culture, and the competitive landscape.

- Passion for taking initiative, simplifying work, and driving constructive change.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Manager, Away from Home Sales (North Carolina)
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity as the Territory Sales Manager, Away from Home Sales (North Carolina)
Be responsible for volume, distribution, profitability of our Away from Home (Foodservice) products and for building customer relationships within this specific geographic territory including cities such as Charlotte and Greensboro. You will focus efforts against key operators primarily within the Non-Commercial channel and Foodservice distributors within your territory.

Location: Working remotely in the North Carolina market .  Must reside preferably within 30 miles of Charlotte, NC (or, if not - must be willing to relocate to the area immediately upon hire).

In this role you will:
- Meet and exceed profit objectives, volume quotas, and equipment & service targets for Away from Home Beverage in your geography

- Establish and maintain relationships within distribution and the non-commercial channel (both unit and headquarter level) including purchasing, sales, finance, marketing, and operations

- Train and work on a cooperative basis with distributor sales organizations, primarily National Account/Healthcare teams

- Maximize profitable beverage sales opportunities through effective use of national/regional/local programs, marketing promotions and distributors

- Develop basic business plans and lead your territory’s execution of business results

- Identify operators and maintain and manage an active pipeline (i.e., branded proposition selling, profitability, volume, and strategic importance)

- Make sound customer business decisions based on customer opportunity, profitability and volume resulting in profitable growth

- Call on key, existing Operators to maintain and grow all strategic categories.

- Effectively manage and maximize beverage equipment placements and product thru put to maximize ROI

- Work cross functionally (National Accounts, Trade, Equipment & Service, Marketing and Finance) to deliver the business results

- Execute plans and programs to achieve maximum sales volume and operating profit objectives while controlling costs and operating within budget

- Identify and challenge status quo based on changes in market, industry and competitive situations that offer opportunity for profitable growth

- Technical proficiency to navigate multiple technologies and systems/tools to manage customer pipeline, current customers, initiatives and asset placements and initiative to deliver the business

- Responsible for profitable qualified asset placements (beverage equipment)

What we are looking for:
Minimum Requirements:
- High School Diploma or GED (Required)

- 2-5 years of B2B or B2C food sales experience

- Be able to lift 50lbs on a regular basis

- Must be able to travel when necessary (averages 4 overnights per month)

- Must reside preferably within 30 miles of Charlotte, NC

- Have a clean driving record

Additional skills and experience that we think would make someone successful in this role:
- Bachelor's Degree (Preferred)

- Foodservice sales experience

- Experience working with Foodservice Distributors

- Ability to act as a team player that collaborates and supports others

- Continually looks for ways to sharpen own skills and business acumen

- Computer skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office: Word, PowerPoint and Excel

- Demonstrated oral and written communication skills and presentations skills

- Data analysis, problem solving skills, and time management skills

- Experience with a customer relationship management (CRM) tool (ex. Salesforce)

- Ability to build customer focused relationships

jobs.title: Business Development Manager, Away from Home Sales-Commercial Chain Accounts
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity as Business Development Manager, Away from Home Sales-Commercial Chain Accounts
In this role you will be responsible for delivering top-line sales & bottom-line profit targets for the commercial national chain foodservice account channel.  You will have individual accountability for developing, executing, overseeing, and leading business activities with assigned Top 300 national chain foodservice accounts and targets to meet brand objectives and sales plan. You will develop, foster, and own the business relationship building strategic sales plans and managing trade spend.  You will also leverage broker management to drive region chain execution in the foodservice segment to achieve sales objectives and KPI’s within the Away From Home Strategic Business Area (SBA).

Location: Preference for Candidates residing in the following places: Atlanta, GA; Charlotte, NC; Orlando, FL; or within the Eastern US and reside near a major airport.

Work Arrangements: Working from home office with up to 60% expected travel.

In this role your primary responsibilities will include:
Business Development
- Achieve assigned volume and margin business plan objectives for Food and Beverage categories supporting SBA plan targets.
- Support the cross-functional development of sales plans, strategies, objectives, policies, and procedures for Smucker business with customers that support the overall business unit objectives.
- Identify and make recommendations concerning changes in market, industry and/or competitive situations that offer opportunities for profitable growth.
- Manage Trade and departmental spend budgets.
- Manage financial business aspects to include P&L statements and margin targets for assigned accounts.
- Proficiency in multiple technology and systems, trade, SDS, CRM, ShowPad, etc.
- Lead region chain account initiatives and targets supporting the broker to include quarterly and annual KPI’s.
- Responsible for maintaining existing business (retention), development of new business across current and new customer base (acquisition), and execution against customer and segment objectives.

Customer Development
- Create and execute defined annual customer business plans with specific growth objectives tied to strategic categories and SBA objectives in beverage and food portfolios.
- Contract development, negotiation, and management for renewals of current business and new business against assigned accounts.
- Plan and execute quarterly business reviews with assigned accounts or as required to drive business and build relationships at various levels with accounts.
- Build broad and strong layered top-down relationships within chain accounts throughout the organization to include Supply Chain, Marketing, and Culinary wiring.
- Cross functional within Smucker and customer (Legal, QA, Customer Marketing, Channel Commercialization, Accounting and Revenue Growth Management).
- Deal with all management levels at the assigned customer to optimize customer relationships and sales results.
- Customer headquarters and field management to include (as necessary) purchasing, marketing, culinary, R&D, operations, senior executives, and field operations.
- Achieve established growth and profitability targets for customer portfolio including P&L input and review.

Business Planning and Analyses
- Analyze business to discover new ways to penetrate existing business and acquire new Top 300 National Chain Foodservice Accounts.
- Execute Top 301-600 Region Chain Foodservice Account strategy supporting our broker chain account network.
- Own Annual Joint Business Planning, Quarterly Business Reviews and other meetings.

What we are looking for:
Minimum Requirements:
- A bachelor’s degree.
- 3+ years managing National Chain Foodservice Account business (including knowledge of the industry, national chain account customers, products, and competition).
- Understanding of Foodservice Supply Chain customer’s needs and opportunities.
- Established experience with Broker Management.
- Strong Negotiation skills.
- Ability to apply strategic thinking and problem solving.
- Travel requirements up to 60% of the time managing face-to-face customer relationships.
- Must reside near a major airport.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Sales Strategy & Planning (Pet Team)
jobs.description:
Your Opportunity as the Associate Manager, Sales Strategy & Planning (Pet Team)
The Associate Manager, Sales Strategy & Planning supports customer planning, performance management, and cross-functional coordination for assigned customers or customer portfolios. This role partners closely with Sales and cross-functional teams to translate business strategies into actionable customer plans, own assigned pieces of the planning work, provide accurate fact-based analysis, and drive follow-through on inputs, updates, and decisions.

All Sales Strategy & Planning roles have customer ownership. At the Associate Manager level, the work is generally differentiated by lower customer complexity, lower ambiguity, and more defined planning needs, while still requiring strong ownership, analytical rigor, and cross-functional follow-through.

Location: JM Smucker Corporate Offices in Orrville, Ohio

Work Arrangements: Hybrid - onsite during core weeks as determined by the Company (estimated up to 9 days a month); adjusted as the need requires. Intermittent business travel may be required.

In this role you will:
Customer Planning & Execution
- Support the customer plan and own assigned pieces of the work, including data, inputs, updates, planning trackers, and follow-through for assigned customers or customer portfolios.
- Support annual planning, Joint Business Planning (JBP), quarterly business reviews, customer planning cycles, innovation planning, and strategic initiatives.
- Translate business priorities into clear customer planning deliverables and understand how assigned work connects to the customer plan and broader business priorities.
- Track key customer planning milestones, decisions, actions, and follow-ups to support timely execution.

Business Performance & Insights
- Provide accurate analysis, reporting, and tracking to build the fact base for planning and decision-making.
- Develop scorecards, business recaps, gap-to-plan analyses, opportunity assessments, and supporting reports.
- Pull together the facts, updates, and analysis needed to support Sales decisions; identify key takeaways and raise issues, risks, and opportunities.
- Help Sales and cross-functional partners understand the “so what” behind customer performance and planning inputs.

Cross-Functional Coordination
- Partner with Sales, Brand Marketing, Category Analytics, Revenue Growth Management, Finance, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders.
- Gather, organize, validate, and connect planning inputs from cross-functional partners in support of customer priorities and business objectives.
- Support alignment meetings and ensure decisions, owners, and next steps are clearly documented.
- Coordinate inputs, follow up on actions, keep work moving, and escalate open issues or inconsistencies to the appropriate decision owner.

Planning Excellence
- Execute established planning processes, tools, templates, and operating rhythms.
- Maintain planning calendars, assumptions, trackers, and reporting resources with accuracy and timeliness.
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that simplify work and improve planning quality.
- Build capability in commercial planning, customer economics, forecasting inputs, and cross-functional ways of working.

Contributing to Organizational Growth & Culture
- Respect all individuals, support efforts for diversity and inclusion, and recognize value in embracing divergent styles.
- Demonstrate a continuous improvement mindset and willingness to challenge the status quo when needed to advance thinking and outcomes.
- Model ownership, accountability, collaboration, and a customer-first mindset with enterprise perspective.

What we are looking for:
Minimum Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree.
- 2 years of experience in Sales Planning, Commercial Planning, Category Management, Sales Analytics, Finance, Marketing, Customer Strategy, or related business functions.
- Experience working with business performance reporting, analytics, and/or customer planning support.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite; including but not limited to Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
- Experience managing multiple priorities, timelines, and stakeholders.
- Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.

Additional skills and experience that we think would make someone successful in this role:
- Consumer Packaged Goods experience.

- Experience using data and insights to support business recommendations.
